name: Sky ICT Public Company Limited
summary: Sky ICT Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in information and communication technology (ICT), and system integration businesses in Thailand. It operates through two segments, System Integration, and Sales and Service. The company offers consulting, design, installation, maintenance, and procurement services; and distributes products and equipment related to ICT and system integration. It develops and trades software; provides information systems and information technology services; and operates aviation services.
